label: Social associations
description: Membership organisations per 10,000 residents - civic and fraternal groups, sports and recreation clubs, religious organisations, political and labour organisations. The standard administrative proxy for how much organised social life a place has; it counts opportunities to belong, not whether people feel they belong.
citation: University of Wisconsin Population Health Institute. County Health Rankings & Roadmaps. www.countyhealthrankings.org — licensed for personal and non-profit use.
